The register says num: "R060/2000-NL1-2012.42", document says "R60/2000-NL1-12-42".

These are both certificate numbers for the same certificate. The register uses "R060" (with zero padding) and full year "2012.42", while document shows "R60" and "12-42". This is a number/year format difference clearly denoting the same certificate — per the rules, that's "same-entity" with the register's canonical form.

Note the certificate_id is 3028 in both, and the num field in the HTML comment matches the register. So the document's rendered "R60/2000-NL1-12-42" is the printed number on the certificate, while the register holds the canonical "R060/2000-NL1-2012.42".

Verdict: same-entity, best_value = "R060/2000-NL1-2012.42" (register canonical form), because the variants differ only in zero-padding and year formatting (12 vs 2012, - vs .) and clearly denote the same certificate (register id 3028 matches cert_id 3028).
